candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: Business responsibility identifies the accountable meaning of a modeled role or action. It is not a database location, runtime worker, access permission or ownership dimension unless the relevant separately owned contract says so.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: The party accountable for an Order is not automatically its database, worker or authorized caller.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: Field collection size, distinct graph endpoint degree, declared step count, Mapping role count and runtime execution count are separate quantities. Closure, feature placement, representation and numeric bounds also remain separate. Compatibility labels alone do not supply bounds.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: A list field, two workflow steps and two operation executions count different things.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: A data shape declares a finite typed field product or typed alternative structure used to carry values. It does not establish domain identity, value equality, lifecycle, table membership or effect authority.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: A record describes what data looks like, not what business concept it is.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: Behavior composition declares participating capabilities, explicit values, guards, transitions, effects and dependencies. It preserves each capability's responsibility rather than making users author a procedural query/set/save script. Lowering requires a separately selected executable contract.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: Say what behavior consists of and how its parts relate; the selected compiler owns the execution form.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: A domain model distinguishes identity-bearing objects, value equality, closed choices, behaviors, lifecycle and public boundaries before choosing their code or storage representation.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: Having fields does not make every concept a record.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: Domain identity, equality, field composition and behavior are declared independently of physical schemas. Persistence and transaction guarantees require their own exact bindings; Entity does not entail one table and a reference does not entail an enforced foreign key.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: Choose what Order means first, then how a particular database stores it.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: A product promise names its consumer, requested outcome, selected scope and exact evidence needed for acceptance. Authored, canonical, implemented, tested, accepted, packaged and published remain independent states.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: Generated files, passing checks and product approval answer different questions.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: An identity field reference names an Entity and an identity field declared on it, preserving target identity rather than embedding that Entity's complete value. Neither storage foreign keys nor owns, belongs-to or contains edges follow automatically.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: Pointing to Order.id means referring to an Order, not storing a nested Order or claiming ownership.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: A formalization binding identifies carrier version, logic fragment, API/provider version, vocabulary and semantics-preserving conversion evidence separately. No newer label silently upgrades old SFOL bytes and no old example replaces unadopted recovered work.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: Say exactly which formal language and conversion were tested.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: The reconciliation ontology classifies and links definition-backed concepts for review. Its labels and review links cannot redefine canonical meanings, add DomainSpec types or relationships, certify proof truth, select providers or authorize effects.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: The ontology is a map of the definitions, not another authority that changes them.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: A supported product promise must retain its meaning through authored concepts, checked graph, selected compiler profile, generated code, observed behavior and exact package. A gap remains work until proved or explicitly removed from scope by its owner.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: Users describe business intent once and can trace what the delivered code does.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: In the proposed Alch authoring profile, a Policy's branch conditions refer to declared Rules with explicit facts and select declared Operation or Calculation targets. Selection is distinct from execution; this does not change DS-D1.8 or admit Policy-to-Rule as a DS-D8 edge.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: Reuse business rules when choosing a strategy; do not hide a second rule language inside Policy.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: A transition's triggering Event is the incoming fact that makes a lifecycle step eligible; an emitted Event is an outgoing consequence. Binding one does not bind the other, even when a particular model chooses the same Event identity.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: What starts a state change is different from what it announces.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: A field type expression combines scalar domains, references to declared types, optionality, ordered lists, uniqueness-constrained sets and tagged alternatives. Each constructor retains its own meaning; this candidate does not choose Alch keywords or extend Enum to payload variants.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: A field can hold a value, a collection, an optional value, or one of several explicitly tagged alternatives.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: DomainSpec meaning owner (role; person not assigned)

candidate_definition.boundary: Candidate reconciliation meaning only; no canonical replacement, syntax admission, product implementation or effect authority.
candidate_definition.normative_voice: A value-flow binding connects a declared output value to a compatible declared input at a composition boundary. It is neither a new canonical DS-D8 relationship nor an implicit execution order or permission to read state.
candidate_definition.plain_language_voice: Pass the calculated total into the mapper visibly.
